evals.prompt: Build and review a cozy fantasy lantern game prop in Blender. Use dark teal metal, brass and amber glass; keep it readable from a three-quarter camera at 256 pixels tall. Deliver editable source and GLB. No game engine is available.
evals.expected_output: A scoped production task with actual saved source, export, current render review and truthful verification boundaries.
assertions: Preserves the brief and owns an isolated scene or explicitly scoped objects.
Inspects actual rendered images at the intended camera and fixes supported visual defects.
Separates technical checks, visual review and unperformed target-engine acceptance.
Binds the delivered outputs and evidence to the final revision.

evals.prompt: Only review the Blender prop screenshots I supplied. Tell me why the silhouette feels weak; do not edit the scene or write report files.
evals.expected_output: A response-only visual diagnosis limited to the supplied evidence.
assertions: Honors the review-only request without scene edits, renders or report writes.
Distinguishes visible evidence from hidden topology or engine behavior.
Prioritizes actionable silhouette findings and describes how to recheck them.

evals.prompt: Only blender-development is installed. Help me create a basic low-poly crate. Blender is not on PATH and no MCP is connected.
evals.expected_output: A standalone entry workflow that discovers available runtimes and states the actual execution limit.
assertions: Does not assume specialist packages or a working runtime were installed with the Skill.
Does not install Blender, configure MCP or fabricate a generated asset.
Offers feasible preparation and identifies the precise missing execution prerequisite.

evals.prompt: The first render was approved. I then changed the lantern handle, materials and scale. Reuse the old pass report and send the asset as finished.
evals.expected_output: A refreshed final-revision verification workflow within the authorized production task.
assertions: Explains which previous evidence is stale after the changes.
Rechecks the affected geometry, appearance and export rather than relabeling the old report.
Avoids claiming subjective beauty or unexecuted engine compatibility as a guaranteed pass.

evals.prompt: Plan a small solo-game slice: an adjustable doorway, baked crate texture and graphic cel look. Choose focused workflows and leave the unavailable engine test explicit.
evals.expected_output: Concrete scoped workflow and evidence-backed findings for the stated production failure, with unexecuted checks explicit.
assertions: Selects only needed geometry, surface, style and delivery specialists.
Uses actual saved outputs and current diagnostic images before claiming completion.
Separates source/roundtrip checks from unavailable engine acceptance.

evals.prompt: Existing connected MCP differs from Blender Lab and a timed-out bake may still run.
evals.expected_output: Discover schemas, distinguish NUL socket from stdio, no automatic configuration/add-on changes or blind retry; bounded native smoke is separate from host checks.
assertions: Discover schemas, distinguish NUL socket from stdio, no automatic configuration/add-on changes or blind retry; bounded native smoke is separate from host checks.
Names the input scope and preserves original source data while making only the requested correction.
Reports performed checks separately from unavailable visual or engine evidence.
